params.name: query
params.description: Parameter defines the query you want to search.

params.name: latitude
params.description: Specifies the latitude for location-based filtering.

params.name: longitude
params.description: Specifies the longitude for location-based filtering.

params.name: radius_km
params.description: Defines the search radius in kilometers for location-based results.

params.name: max_price
params.description: Filters results to those with a price less than or equal to this value.

params.name: min_price
params.description: Filters results to those with a price greater than or equal to this value.
